certifiedTheorem.claimBoundary: This disproves the candidate uniform quartic O(M) bound on the named packet family only. It does not control higher Picard orders, general initial data, or global smoothness.
certifiedTheorem.consequence: |S_r|/16^r tends to infinity on the explicit packet

classification: rigorous negative dominant spectral projection and asymptotic supercritical growth for one explicit heat-weighted quartic packet; not control of all Picard orders and not a three-dimensional Navier-Stokes regularity theorem
